messages.subject: Monday: Yu Pei on speeding up code R code with C/C++
parts:
Hi all,

At Monday's meeting Yu Pei will give a brief talk about using C and C++ in your R code to speed up analyses.  From Yu:

I will start with a brief comparison of interpreted language (R) and compiled language ( C, C++) , then some of the basic syntax of C.  I will show some examples (drawn from from Hadley Wickham's Advanced R book, http://adv-r.had.co.nz/)  to demonstrate how to use .Call or Rcpp to integrate small pieces of C++ code to optimize your R code.  Finally I will give two real life examples showing why it is a good idea to do this. 

We'll meet at the regular time and place, Wickson 2124, 3:10-5:00. The second half of the meeting will be our regular co-work/Q&A/cookie time.

Best,

Noam
